name: esbuild
one_liner: Go-based bundler that made build speed a solved problem, now mostly used inside other tools.
what_it_is: A bundler and minifier written in Go, typically one to two orders of magnitude faster than JavaScript-based equivalents. It is embedded inside many other tools rather than used directly.
why_it_matters: esbuild reset expectations for how long a build should take, and most developers now use it indirectly — it sits inside Vite and several other toolchains. Knowing it exists explains why the current generation of tooling is fast, and it is a good direct choice for simple builds where you do not need a plugin ecosystem.
suitable_for: Simple bundling and minification where speed dominates
not_suitable_for: Projects needing a rich plugin ecosystem or advanced code splitting
Teams wanting a full dev server experience — reach for Vite instead
